_about: The built-in stations on the Radio page, in the order they show. Free stations only.
Edit freely: each station needs id (lowercase, hyphens), name, kind (electronic, world, eclectic, jazz_soul_funk), streams (best first) and source.
logo_text: up to four letters for the logo tile when there is no logo (optional).
streams[].direct: the browser may play this stream itself (https, and the server allows other sites). Everything else is relayed by the server.
now_playing.type: somafm, radioparadise, kexp, nts or radiofrance (core/internet_radio/feeds.py). tracklists.type: kexp or nts.

source says where each address came from. None of these could be fetched from the sandbox this list was written in; they are the stations' published addresses as of 2026 and want a check on a real install (Setup check and Settings > Radio > Check do that).

kinds.blurb: Africa, Latin America, the Caribbean, Asia

stations.name: SomaFM · Drone Zone
stations.description: Served best chilled, safe with most medications. Atmospheric textures with minimal beats. Listener-supported, no ads.
stations.source: SomaFM's channel list (somafm.com/channels.json) and stream naming ice1.somafm.com/<channel>-<kbps>-<codec>; now playing from somafm.com/songs/<channel>.json.

stations.name: SomaFM · Groove Salad
stations.description: A nicely chilled plate of ambient and downtempo beats and grooves.
stations.source: SomaFM's channel list and stream naming; now playing from somafm.com/songs/groovesalad.json.

stations.name: FIP Electro
stations.description: FIP's electronic web radio, from ambient to club, chosen by FIP's programmers. Public service, no ads.
stations.source: Radio France's Icecast addresses (icecast.radiofrance.fr/<station>-hifi.aac, -midfi.mp3). The now-playing address is radiofrance.fr's live API and isn't documented; when it doesn't answer, stream titles and fingerprints take over.

stations.name: dublab
stations.description: Listener-supported radio from Los Angeles since 1999: leftfield, experimental, electronic and beyond, all DJ-presented.
stations.source: dublab's listen page (airtime.pro stream dublab_a). No now-playing feed; titles come from the stream.

stations.name: Radio Paradise · Mellow Mix
stations.description: Radio Paradise's quieter mix: the gentler side of the main mix, with downtempo and ambient. Listener-supported, no ads.
stations.source: Radio Paradise's 'listen in other apps' addresses (stream.radioparadise.com/mellow-flac, -320, -128); now playing from api.radioparadise.com/api/now_playing?chan=1.

stations.name: SomaFM · Deep Space One
stations.description: Deep ambient electronic, experimental and space music. For inner and outer space exploration.
stations.source: SomaFM's channel list and stream naming; now playing from somafm.com/songs/deepspaceone.json.

stations.name: SomaFM · Beat Blender
stations.description: A late-night blend of deep house and downtempo chill.
stations.source: SomaFM's channel list and stream naming; now playing from somafm.com/songs/beatblender.json.

stations.name: SomaFM · Fluid
stations.description: Drown in the electronic sound of instrumental hip-hop, future soul and liquid trap.
stations.source: SomaFM's channel list and stream naming; now playing from somafm.com/songs/fluid.json.

stations.name: FIP Monde
stations.description: FIP's world music web radio: Africa, Latin America, the Caribbean, Asia and the rest.
stations.source: Radio France's Icecast addresses; now playing from radiofrance.fr's undocumented live API (see FIP Electro).

stations.name: Worldwide FM
stations.description: Gilles Peterson's station: global sounds, jazz, soul and dance music from London and around the world.
stations.source: Worldwide FM's player (airtime.pro stream worldwidefm_a). No public now-playing feed; titles come from the stream when it sends them.

stations.name: Radio Paradise · Global Mix
stations.description: Radio Paradise's global mix: music from everywhere, with the same human curation as the main mix.
stations.source: Radio Paradise's 'listen in other apps' addresses (global-flac, -320, -128); now playing from api.radioparadise.com/api/now_playing?chan=3.

stations.name: SomaFM · Suburbs of Goa
stations.description: Desi-influenced Asian world beats and beyond.
stations.source: SomaFM's channel list and stream naming; now playing from somafm.com/songs/suburbsofgoa.json.

stations.name: SomaFM · ThistleRadio
stations.description: Exploring music from Celtic roots and branches.
stations.source: SomaFM's channel list and stream naming; now playing from somafm.com/songs/thistle.json.

stations.name: KEXP
stations.description: Listener-powered radio from Seattle, with DJs who choose every song. Publishes every play, and each show's playlist.
stations.source: KEXP's stream addresses (kexp.streamguys1.com); plays and shows from KEXP's public API (api.kexp.org/v2/plays, /v2/shows).

stations.name: NTS 1
stations.description: Live radio from London, Los Angeles and beyond: hundreds of residents across every genre. Tracklists are published after shows.
stations.source: NTS's stream relay (stream-relay-geo.ntslive.net/stream); what's on and episode tracklists from nts.live/api/v2 (live, and shows/<show>/episodes/<episode>/tracklist).

stations.name: NTS 2
stations.description: NTS's second channel, with its own residents and schedule. Tracklists are published after shows.
stations.source: NTS's stream relay (stream-relay-geo.ntslive.net/stream2); what's on and tracklists from nts.live/api/v2.

stations.name: FIP
stations.description: France's eclectic public station: jazz next to electronic next to chanson, with almost no talk.
stations.source: Radio France's Icecast addresses; now playing from radiofrance.fr's undocumented live API (see FIP Electro).

stations.name: Radio Paradise · Main Mix
stations.description: Eclectic, listener-supported radio since 2000, mixed by hand. Offers a lossless FLAC stream.
stations.source: Radio Paradise's 'listen in other apps' addresses (flac, aac-320, mp3-192); now playing from api.radioparadise.com/api/now_playing?chan=0.
